items.exampleEn: The report baldly states that the project has failed.
items.exampleZh: 報告直截了當地寫明這個專案已經失敗。
items.glossZh: 直截了當地；不加修飾地

items.exampleEn: The final exam had some fiendish questions.
items.exampleZh: 期末考有幾題難得要命。

items.exampleEn: Our first attempt to bake bread failed dismally.
items.exampleZh: 我們第一次試著烤麵包，結果慘敗。

items.exampleEn: The plot of the film is ludicrously complicated.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影的情節複雜得荒謬。

items.exampleEn: She cleans her kitchen fanatically every evening.
items.exampleZh: 她每天晚上都近乎狂熱地打掃廚房。

items.exampleEn: The driver acted negligently by using his phone while driving.
items.exampleZh: 那名駕駛邊開車邊用手機，行為疏忽。

items.exampleEn: The two sisters are temperamentally very different.
items.exampleZh: 這對姊妹在性情上非常不同。

items.exampleEn: The crowd cheered ecstatically when the band came on stage.
items.exampleZh: 樂團一上台，觀眾就欣喜若狂地歡呼。

items.sentenceEn: He is temperamentally suited to a quiet job in a library.
items.sentenceZh: 就個性而言，他很適合在圖書館做安靜的工作。

items.audioEn: The new jacket was ludicrously expensive, so I bought a cheaper one online.
items.audioZh: 那件新外套貴得離譜，所以我在網路上買了一件比較便宜的。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼沒買那件新外套？
options: It felt too heavy to wear.
It did not come in the right size.
The color looked different in daylight.
It cost far too much money.

items.sentenceEn: Our small shop did dismally in its first year.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的小店第一年的生意慘淡。

items.sentenceEn: The baker followed his grandmother's recipe almost fanatically.
items.sentenceZh: 那位麵包師傅幾乎狂熱地遵照他奶奶的食譜。

items.stemEn: The new phone is ____ expensive; it costs more than my monthly rent.
items.stemZh: 那支新手機貴得離譜，比我一個月的房租還貴。

items.stemEn: The puzzle was ____: it took the three of us over three hours to solve.
items.stemZh: 那個謎題難得要命：我們三個人花了三個多小時才解開。

items.passageEn: My brother Owen supports our local football team fanatically. Last season, however, the team played dismally and lost eight games in a row. The coach blamed the defenders, who had marked their opponents negligently. Owen, who is temperamentally unable to stay quiet, wrote a letter to the club. In it, he stated baldly that the ticket prices were ludicrously high for such poor football. The last match of the season was against the league leaders, and a fiendish schedule meant the players had only two days to rest. Still, they won 2-1. Owen ran around the living room ecstatically and spontaneously hugged our grandmother.
items.passageZh: 我哥哥 Owen 狂熱地支持我們當地的足球隊。不過上一季，球隊表現慘淡，連輸了八場。教練怪罪後衛，說他們防守時太疏忽。Owen 天性就是沒辦法保持沉默，於是寫了一封信給球會。他在信中直截了當地說，以這麼差的球賽水準來說，票價高得離譜。本季最後一場對手是聯賽龍頭，而極度緊湊的賽程讓球員只有兩天可以休息。儘管如此，他們還是以二比一獲勝。Owen 欣喜若狂地在客廳裡跑來跑去，還一時興起抱住了我們的奶奶。

options: 後衛的表現其實很不錯
他願意免費幫球隊宣傳

questions.questionZh: 最後一場比賽前，球員面臨什麼困難？
options: 對手剛換了新教練和新球員

items.promptZh: 那名員工因為疏忽，把重要的文件弄丟了。
referenceEn: The employee negligently lost some important documents.
Acting negligently, the worker lost the important files.
rubricZh: 「疏忽地」用副詞 negligently 修飾動作（例如 negligently lost、acted negligently）
說的是已發生的事，時態配合內容（例如 lost）

items.promptZh: 得知自己考上了夢想中的大學，她欣喜若狂地打電話給爸媽。
referenceEn: When she learned she had got into her dream university, she ecstatically called her parents.
After hearing that her dream university had accepted her, she called her parents ecstatically.
rubricZh: 「欣喜若狂地」用 ecstatically，位置有彈性
「考上」可寫，例如 got into、was accepted by 等
說的是已發生的事，時態配合內容；過去式、現在完成式都正確
